##### Project general facts

DAMAC Coral Reef is an exciting residential endeavor in a prestigious waterfront location, made possible through a collaboration with a renowned sculpture artist, creating a true manifestation of opulence meeting convenience. This high-rise tower presents a collection of one to three-bedroom apartments with captivating views of the sea and tropical gardens, showcasing unique interior design elements. Every inch has been meticulously designed to cater to the needs of its residents, demonstrating a devotion to detail that ensures a comfortable and convenient lifestyle.

Residents are treated to an abundance of entertainment and leisure options right within the premises, including infinity pools, a stunning lobby with concierge services, and a well-equipped gymnasium. The waterfront location ensures breathtaking views and a soothing ambience that perfectly blends luxury and comfort, with exclusive waterfront amenities including inviting beach areas and alluring tropical gardens. This collaboration elevates luxury living to unparalleled heights, creating an address that stands as a testament to artistry and refinement.

Each residence features porcelain tiled floors, painted walls, and built-in wardrobes in bedrooms, while bathrooms include porcelain tiles, vanity tops, shower enclosures, and premium sanitary ware. The kitchens are fitted with cabinetry, stone countertops, stainless steel sinks, and premium appliances including refrigerators, cookers, and kitchen hoods. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home where art, comfort, and luxury converge seamlessly.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is surrounded by popular entertainment and leisure spots, making it perfect for explorers and fun-seekers with attractions like museums, parks, beaches, and shopping destinations all within easy reach. Families benefit from easy access to esteemed educational institutions within a short drive, ensuring quality education for children. Healthcare needs are well-catered to with access to top medical facilities offering a range of services for residents.

The strategic location provides convenient access to key attractions and amenities throughout Dubai. The area's thoughtful positioning ensures that residents can enjoy both the tranquility of waterfront living and the vibrancy of city life. The community's proximity to world-class entertainment, education, and healthcare facilities creates a truly integrated living experience.

The location's combination of luxury, convenience, and accessibility makes it an ideal choice for those seeking a remarkable living experience. The area's ongoing development and strategic position continue to enhance its appeal as a premier residential destination. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of artistic inspiration, waterfront serenity, and urban accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most distinctive communities.
